queries.text: The interview marks questions with "P -" (pergunta, question); rendered "Q:" throughout.

"pedaço de mau caminho" (literally "a piece of the wrong road") is a colloquial expression for an irresistibly attractive person who leads one astray; rendered "a walking temptation". Alternative: "a heartbreaker".
"fêmea fatal" (a play on "femme fatale") rendered "fatal female" to keep the approved glossary term "female". Alternative: "femme fatale".
"vagabundas" (Brazilian slang, roughly "sluts") rendered "sluts", distinct from "vadias" (glossary: tramps) in the next sentence.
"o resto é aderente" (literally "the rest is adherent/attached") rendered "the rest is an attachment". Alternative: "the rest just comes along with it".
The original spells "Farrel"; corrected to Farrell, as in the bibliography (Warren Farrell and James P. Sterba, "Does Feminism Discriminate against Men?").
